deviations: glmnet/lassopack are not available, so the post-double-selection lasso is a hand-written rigorous (plug-in) lasso in the style of Stata's lassopack rlasso/pdslasso: coordinate descent, cluster-robust (clinic) penalty loadings iterated on post-lasso residuals (initialised from OLS on the 5 most correlated regressors), lambda = 2*1.1*sqrt(N)*qnorm(1-gamma/(2p)), gamma = 0.1/log(N_clusters). The exact Stata penalty settings used by the authors are not stated in the paper, so selected controls may differ slightly from theirs.
notes: Sample: dropme==0 in LSS_analysis_datasets_20201108.dta (2055 in-clinic interviews; 2053 with prescription/purchase outcomes). Outcomes: used_vouchers_admin, RXtreat_sev_simple_mal, treat_sev_simple_mal, RXtreat_severe_mal, treat_severe_mal (control-group means match Table 3 exactly: 0.616/0.461/0.303/0.255). Treatments: patient_voucher, doctor_voucher (PI cross-cut not controlled, as in eq. 1). Candidate controls: the dataset's pre-built CC* individual controls (missings mean-coded plus missing dummies), their pairwise CCxCC interactions, and CL* clinic dummies (331 in all). Date FE (date_morning_survey) partialled out before the lasso; lasso run for the outcome, PV and DV separately and the union of selected controls used in an OLS with date FE and clinic-clustered SEs (fixest). Attempts 1-2 were exploratory (variable listing, sample counts), no RESULT lines. The first estimating run (final) matched all claims to reported precision except severe-prescribed PV (-0.0448 vs -0.046); no claim-driven changes were made. No run hung.
